jobs.title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Introduction:   Ready to build the platform behind Europe's smartest parking? At Peter Park, we replace barriers and paper tickets with computer vision and cloud software, across 90,000+ parking spaces in four countries. As our (Senior) DevOps Engineer, you'll own the AWS and Kubernetes platform that keeps it all running: automating everything worth automating, and making sure it scales reliably as the traffic grows.    Your Objectives & Role:     Work on an amazing product  with b2b and b2c aspects at the intersection of mobility and property technology   Shape the architecture of our cloud and microservice platform.  You'll help decide how we run on AWS and Kubernetes, and how our services are built, connected and secured, all codified in Terraform.   Build the developer experience you always wished you had.  Our frontend, backend and IoT teams should get a platform with self-service, fast feedback and golden paths, so shipping feels effortless and the infrastructure stays out of their way.   Automate DevOps with AI agents.  We already use AI agents for investigations, reviews and routine ops work. You'll help us push further and design the guardrails that make it safe.   Make CI/CD fast and boring in the best way.  You'll keep evolving our GitLab pipelines for backend and IoT deployments, so we can deploy to production continuously and with confidence.   Turn observability into a superpower.  You'll improve how we monitor our services with Datadog, so we spot issues before customers do and every alert is worth waking up for.   Scale for thousands of parking lots and beyond.  You'll make sure our systems keep up as the network grows, with reliability, cost and performance in mind.   Shape our engineering culture.  You'll champion modern practices: clean, well-tested and efficient code, infrastructure as code, and blameless learning.     Your Expertise, Skills & Mindset:     Experienced DevOps Engineer:  Not defined by years of experience but striving for continuous improvement, direct impact on the business, and ownership   Cloud & Kubernetes:  You have deep hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes (ideally EKS) in production, including GitOps and CI/CD.   Reliability:  You know observability, meaningful alerting, and incident response, and you build with security by default.   Coding & AI:  You write automation in Python or TypeScript and use agentic AI tools every day.   Nice to have:  Experience with IoT/edge deployments or running databases at scale.  Excellent written and spoken  English  skills (level C1). German language proficiency is not required     Technologies We Work With:     Cloud:  AWS, with multi-account, multi-AZ networking, provisioned with Terraform in a modular, stack-based setup   Orchestration:  Kubernetes (EKS) with Karpenter autoscaling, Envoy Gateway for ingress, KEDA for event-driven scaling and Helm for packaging   Delivery:  GitOps and progressive delivery with Argo CD and Argo Rollouts, GitLab CI/CD pipelines for backend, frontend and IoT deployments   Observability:  Datadog for metrics, logs, APM and alerting across the whole stack   Serverless:  AWS Lambda with the Serverless Framework for high-throughput endpoints   Data:  Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, ElastiCache Redis, S3, plus Redshift for analytics   AI tooling:   Claude Code, MCP- and agentic based tooling that automate day-to-day ops work   What you'll be building for:  event-driven microservices in TypeScript/NestJS (BullMQ, Prisma) and Python, and a Vue.js frontend monorepo (Turbo, pnpm, changesets, Storybook)     Work Setup:     Hours : 40 hours per week (based on trust).   Home Office Policy:  Enjoy a hybrid model with 3 days in the office / 2 days remote.   Contract : A permanent contract for long-term stability   Location : Our modern office in Munich, a vibrant city in the heart of Bavaria.     Our Recruiting Process:      Initial Contact:  We’ll get back to you within 48 hours.   HR Interview:  Discuss you

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
jobs.description:
About  Pleo   
 Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. 
 The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. 
 Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. 

   Please note:  applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.  

  About the role  
 We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source. 

  Who you’ll be working with and reporting to   
 You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams. 

  What you’ll be doing  
 As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will: 
 
 
 Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination). 
 
 
 Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance. 
 
 
 Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature. 
 
 
 Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure. 
 
 
 Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas. 
 
 
 Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols. 
 
 
 Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services. 
 
 
 Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy. 
 
 
 Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails. 
 
 
 To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
StackAdapt  is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. 
 StackAdapt is seeking a talented  Senior Quality Engineer  who is passionate about software quality and test automation to be part of a highly impactful team that will directly affect the success of product releases in a cross-functional agile environment. In addition, you will be responsible for implementing reliable and scalable automation test cases and integrating them into our CI/CD pipeline. These initiatives will serve to enhance our software quality, accelerate our defect detection and prevention capabilities as well as transform our software development process. 
 Learn more about our engineering culture here:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LXM2NrkhKZc  
 StackAdapt is a remote-first company; we are open to candidates located anywhere in North America for this position. 
 What You'll Be Doing: 
 
 Participate in the development of in-house automated and functional test scripts and tooling that address areas such as functional, system, API, integration, UI and regression testing  
 Work collaboratively with Platform, Product, DevOps, and other teams in order to deploy and run automated tests on test environments with CI/CD 
 Provide timely test result feedback to the Platform Team, the QA team and other relevant stakeholders 
 Participate in technical planning, code review and architectural decision-making 
 
 What You'll Bring to the Table: 
 
 At least 4 years of professional, hands-on test automation experience with API & UI test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Mocha, Jest or Junit 
 Knowledge of React, including but not limited to adding data-testids 
 Ability to explore codebase and utilize other technical tools to gain an understanding of technical implementation 
 Fluency in at least one of Javascript, Typescript, Python, or Java 
 Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Github Actions, CircleCI 
 Strong understanding of scalable system design for web-based APIs and backend processing systems 
 In-depth understanding of QA methodologies in a software company with short release cycles 
 Experience writing test cases that cover edge/negative cases, compatibility, and concurrency tests in test case management tools like TestRail 
 Experience working with relational databases 
 Hands-on experience with SQL and ability to query for large data sets 
 
 The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location.  We do not ask c andidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer. 
 This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. 
  Factors Influencing Final Compensation:  
 
 The final compensation offer will be determined by a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to: the candidate's specific experience, technical skills, knowledge, abilities, and relevant education, licensure, and certifications. 
 Other business factors, such as organizational needs and budget alignment, may also be considered in the final offer. 
 
 Canada B

new_jobs.title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description: Introduction:   Ready to build the platform behind Europe's smartest parking? At Peter Park, we replace barriers and paper tickets with computer vision and cloud software, across 90,000+ parking spaces in four countries. As our (Senior) DevOps Engineer, you'll own the AWS and Kubernetes platform that keeps it all running: automating everything worth automating, and making sure it scales reliably as the traffic grows.    Your Objectives & Role:     Work on an amazing product  with b2b and b2c aspects at the intersection of mobility and property technology   Shape the architecture of our cloud and microservice platform.  You'll help decide how we run on AWS and Kubernetes, and how our services are built, connected and secured, all codified in Terraform.   Build the developer experience you always wished you had.  Our frontend, backend and IoT teams should get a platform with self-service, fast feedback and golden paths, so shipping feels effortless and the infrastructure stays out of their way.   Automate DevOps with AI agents.  We already use AI agents for investigations, reviews and routine ops work. You'll help us push further and design the guardrails that make it safe.   Make CI/CD fast and boring in the best way.  You'll keep evolving our GitLab pipelines for backend and IoT deployments, so we can deploy to production continuously and with confidence.   Turn observability into a superpower.  You'll improve how we monitor our services with Datadog, so we spot issues before customers do and every alert is worth waking up for.   Scale for thousands of parking lots and beyond.  You'll make sure our systems keep up as the network grows, with reliability, cost and performance in mind.   Shape our engineering culture.  You'll champion modern practices: clean, well-tested and efficient code, infrastructure as code, and blameless learning.     Your Expertise, Skills & Mindset:     Experienced DevOps Engineer:  Not defined by years of experience but striving for continuous improvement, direct impact on the business, and ownership   Cloud & Kubernetes:  You have deep hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes (ideally EKS) in production, including GitOps and CI/CD.   Reliability:  You know observability, meaningful alerting, and incident response, and you build with security by default.   Coding & AI:  You write automation in Python or TypeScript and use agentic AI tools every day.   Nice to have:  Experience with IoT/edge deployments or running databases at scale.  Excellent written and spoken  English  skills (level C1). German language proficiency is not required     Technologies We Work With:     Cloud:  AWS, with multi-account, multi-AZ networking, provisioned with Terraform in a modular, stack-based setup   Orchestration:  Kubernetes (EKS) with Karpenter autoscaling, Envoy Gateway for ingress, KEDA for event-driven scaling and Helm for packaging   Delivery:  GitOps and progressive delivery with Argo CD and Argo Rollouts, GitLab CI/CD pipelines for backend, frontend and IoT deployments   Observability:  Datadog for metrics, logs, APM and alerting across the whole stack   Serverless:  AWS Lambda with the Serverless Framework for high-throughput endpoints   Data:  Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, ElastiCache Redis, S3, plus Redshift for analytics   AI tooling:   Claude Code, MCP- and agentic based tooling that automate day-to-day ops work   What you'll be building for:  event-driven microservices in TypeScript/NestJS (BullMQ, Prisma) and Python, and a Vue.js frontend monorepo (Turbo, pnpm, changesets, Storybook)     Work Setup:     Hours : 40 hours per week (based on trust).   Home Office Policy:  Enjoy a hybrid model with 3 days in the office / 2 days remote.   Contract : A permanent contract for long-term stability   Location : Our modern office in Munich, a vibrant city in the heart of Bavaria.     Our Recruiting Process:      Initial Contact:  We’ll get back to you within 48 hours.   HR Interview:  Discuss you
